ignoreValues.reason: Pre-existing platform typography: Inter predates all remediation phases, is loaded via a deliberate async media=print swap with a noscript fallback, and is Daffodil International College's branding. Changing the institution's typeface is not mine to decide inside a location-system phase.

House type policy from an earlier phase: 12px floor on mobile (enforced with !important lifts at styles.css:4229+), 11px for desktop secondary metadata only. The stricter undersized-ui-text rule stays active and now reports 0, so no functional text sits below the 11px floor.
False positive: .topbar sets padding 0 24px but has a fixed height with align-items:center, so children are vertically centred, not flush against the border. Confirmed visually.

Two cases, both deliberate: body sets overflow-x:hidden only (the standard horizontal-scroll guard; vertical overflow stays visible so popovers escape), and .login-screen clips its two decorative .login-orb gradients. Zero horizontal overflow measured at all seven widths.
The two uses are brand wordmarks (.brand-name, .id-logo), not headings or metrics. Both now paint dark stops, #0B3897 to #00786A, measured 5.39:1 at the lighter end.
The two login-screen orbs are pre-existing brand visuals, not a Phase 7A addition, and are now disabled under prefers-reduced-motion.
Live, tenant and typing indicators. The state they report is also carried by colour and by the adjacent label, and all three now stop under prefers-reduced-motion.
The .progress-fill shimmer is decorative and now stops under prefers-reduced-motion.
All six are progress and funnel fills. transform:scaleX would distort .funnel-fill's left-padded inner label and its gradient, so animating width is the correct implementation here.
